name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: 6 coins goes with neither Beatrix nor Cooper.
At most one of (the members of the Joiners' Guild, Wulfric, and Beatrix) goes with (6 coins or 10 coins).
Beatrix's levy is at least 4 coins more than the Cooper.
Either Blacksmith goes with Aldric or Potter goes with 8 coins.
Godfrey's levy is lower than both Matilda and Wulfric.
Between Wulfric and 4 coins, one goes with Blacksmith and the other with Mason.
